dialogs.about: 할아버지와 안경을 찾으며 시력 이야기를 해요

lines.en: Grandpa, where are my reading glasses?
lines.ko: 할아버지, 제 돋보기 안경 어디 있어요?

lines.en: They are on the table. Do you see them?
Oh, yes. But the letters look blurred today.
lines.ko: 아, 네. 그런데 오늘은 글자가 흐릿해 보여요.

lines.en: Is your vision worse than last year?
A little. My lenses are old and dirty.
Let me clean them. Please blink and rest your eyes.
lines.ko: 제가 닦을게요. 눈 깜박이고 좀 쉬세요.

lines.en: I read a small chart at the eye doctor yesterday.
How was it?
Fine. The doctor said I will need new glasses.
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 새 안경이 필요할 거라고 하셨어요.

lines.en: I see. Let's go to the shop tomorrow.
Hello. How can I help you today?
My vision is blurred. I need new glasses.
Please read this chart. Can you see the first line?
lines.ko: 이 시력표를 읽어 보세요. 첫 줄 보이세요?

lines.en: Yes, but the small ones are hard.
Please blink two times and look again.
Now it's better. My eyelid felt heavy this morning.
lines.ko: 이제 낫네요. 오늘 아침엔 눈꺼풀이 무거웠어요.

lines.en: Rest your eyes often. Which lens do you want?
lines.ko: 눈을 자주 쉬게 하세요. 어떤 렌즈로 하시겠어요?

lines.en: A light one, please. When will it be ready?
lines.ko: 가벼운 걸로 부탁해요. 언제 다 될까요?

lines.en: It will be ready on Friday morning.
Thank you. I'm going to come after lunch.
